title: Roar on the Dragon-Steps
summary: Tiger-monk retainers between Tiger Plains Village and Tosh Raka's Palace guard the border-pass against serpent-court saboteurs trying to disrupt Tosh Raka's apotheosis bells.

hook.rumour: Saboteurs wearing scaled cloaks slipped past Tiger Plains Village at dusk carrying alchemical dampening-pitch toward the great bronze bells of Tosh Raka's Palace.
hook.notice: TIGER PLAINS MONASTERY GUARD: Warriors sought to escort the bell-oil convoy up the Dragon-Steps to Tosh Raka's Palace.

npcs.name: Warden of Tiger Plains Village
npcs.greet: Saboteurs wearing scaled cloaks slipped past Tiger Plains Village at dusk carrying alchemical dampening-pitch toward the great bronze bells of Tosh Raka's Palace.
talk: The trouble across Ka Po' Tun began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Tiger Plains Village.
If you mean to help the Tiger-Monk Retainers, start by checking the trail between Tiger Plains Village and Tosh Rakas Palace.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Tiger Plains Village
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Tosh Rakas Palace is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Tosh Rakas Palace toward Ka Po Tun Steppe Fort before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Tiger Plains Village so Grand Monk Raka-Shan can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Ka Po Tun Steppe Fort
npcs.greet: You made good time from Tosh Rakas Palace. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Dragon Graveyard of Akavir.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Dragon Graveyard of Akavir with a picked guard.
Once Dragon Graveyard of Akavir is cleared, return to Tiger Plains Village to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Tiger Plains Village
npcs.greet: Grand Monk Raka-Shan awaits word on whether the crisis in Ka Po' Tun has been contained.
talk: The elders of Tiger Plains Village have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Ka Po' Tun owes you a debt for standing between Tiger Plains Village and ruin.
